articles.title: Crypto market structure can't wait for shot at post-election Clarity Act surge: White House
articles.snippet: White House and U.S. Treasury officials agree that despite some hope that Congress' "lame duck" session could see the bill again, the work's in regulators' hands.

articles.title: Animoca Brands delays IPO plans, suspends merger talks with Currenc
articles.snippet: Talks between the two kicked off late last year, with plans for the former to own 95% of the merged company.

articles.title: Cardano joins Solana, XRP Ledger in race to power AI agent payments
articles.snippet: The official x402 kit now includes Cardano tools for apps and AI agents to pay with ADA and other network tokens, though the facilitator has so far only been tested on pre-production.

articles.title: Why banks and offshore hubs like Dubai are winners of the Senate killing the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: One expert believes that the failure to pass the bill is a win for the banks that staunchly oppose stablecoin yields, while a global crypto lawyer believes overseas jurisdictions benefit.

articles.title: Zcash gets first European ETP following US ETF launch
articles.snippet: 21shares listed physically backed ZEC and ETHFI products on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam, as issuers broaden their offerings beyond major cryptocurrencies.
